# Project knowledge (full)

## Must rules

<rule id="rul_01a106d3f0d07799be3d140f90cc5c88" severity="must" trust="0.50">
Before task cws:publish, bring the Store listing up to date first (screenshots in brand/store/, description) in the dashboard, and confirm with the user. Submitting for review locks the whole listing until review completes, so stale listing assets then need a second review or a cancelled one. Order: task package -> task cws:upload -> update listing in dashboard -> ask -> task cws:publish.
</rule>

<rule id="rul_01a124a9ee157756843f9646d6340fb1" severity="must" trust="0.50">
Version bumps are small and patch-first: each release bumps the PATCH (0.3.0 -> 0.3.1 -> 0.3.2), never jumps the minor per batch of features as 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0 did. A minor or major bump only when the user asks for it. Chrome Web Store versions can never go down, so the next release continues from the last uploaded version (0.3.0 -> 0.3.1); propose the exact version and ask before bumping. User, 2026-10-10: 'why we publish like 0.3.0 this is wrong we should have 0.1.0, 0.1.1 etc'.
</rule>
